recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add Specimen organization or container-location search parameters unless OO approves a new search design that avoids the cross-resource resolve() concerns and aligns with the DeviceAssociation-based owner model.
issue_request: FHIR-40559 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO change request to remove Specimen.container.location, add an organization search parameter for the first organization in the container device hierarchy, and add a container-location search parameter for the device container location.
initial_application: The issue was applied in 777ac658 and merged by 7d6b4fc; that implementation removed Specimen.container.location, added a FiveWs.where mapping exception, and added Specimen organization/location search parameters. Follow-up commit 38074c13 renamed the location parameter to container-location to match the Jira resolution.
additional_context: FHIR-51907 later removed the Specimen organization search parameter because it would not return Specimen resources and chained search was preferred. FHIR-51580 later removed container-location and other Specimen search parameters that depended on cross-resource resolve() evaluation. Current source keeps the container device reference and Device.location remains available on Device.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Specimen source is correct after the later issue family: Specimen.container.location remains removed, and the active Specimen search-parameter bundle intentionally lacks organization and container-location.
